segments.name: Consumer Lending
segments.description: Originates, owns and services refinance and in-school private education loans for students and their families.
segments.evidence: Navient owns, originates and services refinance and in-school Private Education Loans.

segments.name: Federal Education Loans
segments.description: Holds and services FFELP education loans guaranteed under a federal program discontinued in 2010.
segments.evidence: The Federal Family Education Loan Program, formerly the Guaranteed Education Loan Program, a program that was discontinued in 2010.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Reportable segment reported alongside Consumer Lending and Federal Education Loans.
segments.evidence: We monitor and assess our ongoing operations and results based on the following three reportable operating segments: Consumer Lending, Federal Education Loans, and Other.

revenueModel.text: Students and families borrow education loans from the company, which earns interest income on those loans.
revenueModel.evidence: Private Education Loans — Education loans to students or their families that bear the full credit risk of the customer and any cosigner.

changes.text: The Business Processing segment was divested, with its government services business sold in February 2025.
changes.evidence: As of February 2025, we had divested our Business Processing segment.
